blurb: Iceoplex Simi Valley is a training center with two ice sheets offering hockey, figure skating, curling, speed skating, synchronized skating, and ice theater. They provide skating school programs for all ages and skill levels, including figure skating and hockey classes. The facility hosts public skating sessions, adult hockey leagues, and group fundraising events.
